text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cinema Gun captured a glimpse of the 
reason behind Furioso's bottomless 
strength in the February Stakes. It was 
the white dust of Funabashi clinging to 
her legs—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furioso still returns to Funabashi to 
train to this day, eager to prove the 
strength of her hometown to the JRA 
Central.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her driving force was "love for her 
hometown." Transcend, too, shared a 
relatable desire to bring joy to the 
people she interacted with.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From rebellious spirits to hometown pride. 
The reasons the strong chose to run were 
wildly varied—and every single one was 
crucial intel.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To gather information on Smart Falcon, one 
of the Big Three, the next goal was set as 
the Teio Sho. Morale was riding high for 
the upcoming race, but...
